sloka: एष रावणवीर्येण लक्ष्मणः पतितः क्षितौ ।सर्पवद्वेष्टते वीरो मम शोकमुदीरयन् ।। ६.१०२.३ ।।
transliteration: eṣa rāvaṇavīryeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ patitaḥ kṣitau ।sarpavadveṣṭate vīro mama śokamudīrayan ।। 6.102.3 ।।

translations.english: 'Heroic Lakshmana struck by Ravana, fell on the ground and writhing like a snake and rolling made me sad'.
